Nothing can be read through the app. Invitation acceptance, notifications, digests, reminders, and webhook deliveries all stop. Plan changes are not recorded because the subscription ends at closing. Blocking archived organizations in resolveActorForOrg would also prevent legitimate actions like issue creation from working. The fix requires special-casing the delete action: requireActorFor should accept archived organizations, while other actions continue to reject them.
